items.title: Write product README with capabilities and non-goals
items.notes: Session zero, build, campaign fit, GM handoff; Player/GM modes; tech intent; rules sources.

items.title: Draft phased delivery roadmap through polish and share
items.notes: Phases 0–6 plus later non-goals and open decisions in ROADMAP.md.

items.title: Define early-scope exclusions and campaign-safe non-goals
items.notes: No full feat/spell/equipment catalogs; no Foundry/Pathbuilder; no multi-PC balancing; no player-facing ritual spoilers.

items.title: Document Player and GM mode audiences and content
items.notes: Player: invitation, questions, build, soft tips. GM: same build plus scapegoat/stake and deity hooks.

items.title: Record Vite + TypeScript and attribute-engine reuse intent
items.notes: Local-first static app; port normalizeBuild/ancestryRule/calculate; Player Core catalogs first; share URL + JSON/Markdown exports.

items.title: Add agent-ready docs, AGENTS.md, and name-roadmap JSON
items.notes: docs/overview through roadmap-format; roadmap/*.json; README Documentation links.

items.title: Scaffold Vite + TypeScript local-first app
items.notes: New app or monorepo sibling next to pf2e-point-buy-calc. Node 22.18+ or 24+. Exit: app runs locally.

items.title: Design a Pharasma-inspired favicon and header emblem
items.notes: Share one SVG between the header and browser tab. Combine Pharasma's spiraling comet with a fractured silver masquerade mask.

items.title: Illustrate the shell with a fractured mirror and a candle spiral
items.notes: Replace the star cluster with a static silver filigree mirror inspired by the arrival at House Verathe.

items.title: Frame the favicon and header mask with a fractured mirror
items.notes: Replace the comet with fractured oval glass inspired by the shell backdrop.

items.title: Replace the backdrop candles with silver sparkles
items.notes: Set four-point glints along the mirror's spiral.

items.title: Extract or copy attribute engine from pf2e-point-buy-calc
items.notes: Port options, normalizeBuild, ancestryRule, calculate, and serialize/parse. Do not reimplement boost math.

items.title: Port smoke tests for Remaster boost math
items.notes: Reuse or port test/build.test.ts from the point-buy calculator. Exit: empty shell loads a default level-1 build.

items.title: Add shared Build and SessionZero types
items.notes: Mechanical Build plus new SessionZero answers for invitation, stake, art, faith, mask.

items.title: Add Player / GM mode toggle with GM panel hidden by default
items.notes: Player-safe default; GM wiring only when toggled.

items.title: Ship player-safe invitation blurb and guided questions
items.notes: Why accept; who matters (or self as watched); art/craft; optional deity (Pharasma / Nocticula / Black Butterfly / none); mask concept. No ritual spoilers.

items.title: Persist session-zero answers in localStorage and export JSON/Markdown
items.notes: Player can finish questions and take answers with them.

items.title: Guide players through Pathfinder 2e Remaster character creation step by step
items.notes: The invitation and character concept guide ships in Phase 1 with progress and editable review. Extend the same flow through the mechanical build for players with tabletop experience who are new to Pathfinder 2e Remaster. Introduce rules at the relevant choice, including ancestry boosts and class key attributes.

items.title: Port attribute creator UI from the point-buy calculator
items.notes: Ancestry / background / class / level / milestones / voluntary flaws. Player Core and Player Core 2 first; custom rows otherwise.

items.title: Save build choices and progress across refreshes
items.notes: Store the mechanical build and current guide step separately from session-zero answers.

items.title: Add share link and printable attribute ledger for the mechanical build
items.notes: Mechanical side only; Exit: full Remaster attribute planning works in-app.

items.title: Remove the mode switch from the player interface
Score builds against night demands (Will, Perception, social, Stealth/Thievery)
items.notes: Also cover Athletics climax interventions, optional Religion, Performance flavor. Same scores for player and GM.

items.title: Place the campaign title above the app name
items.notes: Replace the invitation line and remove the repeated title below the app name.

items.title: Suggest campaign-fit backgrounds and classes as hints not locks
items.notes: Backgrounds e.g. Artist, Entertainer, Noble, Acolyte, Detective; classes e.g. Bard, Rogue, Investigator, Oracle, Witch, Cleric, Swashbuckler.

items.title: Describe the three deities on the faith step
items.notes: Give a brief, player-safe description of Pharasma, Nocticula, and the Black Butterfly.

items.title: Flag builds that lean hard into combat-as-default
items.notes: Show an advisory for finished builds with a strong attack attribute, another high physical modifier, and less support for Wisdom, Charisma, and Intelligence checks.

items.title: Add level-appropriate skill increase planner mapped to campaign fit
items.notes: Completed attributes unlock level-1 training, named Lore skills, class-based increases, and Intelligence training. Planned skill ranks and base modifiers appear in campaign fit. The plan saves in the local draft.

items.title: Export and restore a single player character file
items.notes: A versioned JSON file combines session-zero answers, attributes, planned skills, and guide progress. It supports unfinished characters and requires confirmation before replacing the browser draft.

items.title: Polish tone and CSS for a masquerade-adjacent readable UI
items.notes: Use a midnight-blue masthead, silver progress bars, and a framed invitation with a mirror wax seal. Apply consistent guide headings and panels, and fit the skill table to narrow screens.

items.title: Fill README Run locally with real commands and ports
items.notes: Document Node and npm setup, dependency installation, development, tests, lint, build, and local preview. Include default ports and Vite’s behavior when a port is busy.

items.title: Explain ancestry, background, and class options before selection
items.notes: Summaries and direct Remaster rules links cover all presets. Players can search descriptions, choose an option from the results, or use the dropdown.

items.title: Make default start level configurable by the GM
items.notes: VITE_CAMPAIGN_START_LEVEL sets the level for new drafts and falls back to 1. Saved levels are preserved. The campaign’s intended starting level is an open decision.

items.title: Optionally deploy static build like pf.starmist.studio
items.notes: The maintainer confirmed that pushes to main trigger Vercel builds.

items.title: Add optional starting language notes to the character guide
items.notes: The build review links to general language and ancestry rules. The optional notes save with the draft and round-trip through the character file.

items.title: Add a password-protected GM entry outside the player interface
items.notes: The Vercel Function guards the GM workspace and its assets. The workspace imports a player character for read-only review. Production activation requires configuring the password and deploying.

items.title: Auto-generate spoiler-gated GM tailoring brief with copy-to-clipboard
items.notes: Importing a character generates editable suggestions for the invitation, intended victim, art, deity, mask competition, and planned skills. Copy the Markdown into session notes or regenerate it from the character. All campaign hooks are confined to the protected GM build.

items.title: Serve the protected GM route in local development and preview
items.notes: Reuse the server-side password check in Vite dev and preview. Load the local password from environment files, deny raw GM source and build files, and document the gm username and private build command.

items.title: Ship single export package and import for prior exports
items.notes: The public character package preserves player answers, build, skills, and language notes. The protected GM workspace now exports a separate versioned package containing the character and exact edited session notes, and imports either kind of file. Invalid packages preserve the current workspace and the public importer rejects GM packages.

items.title: Add heritage and ancestry feat choices
items.notes: Added a skippable heritage and ancestry feat step with 106 heritages and 403 ancestry feats from Player Core and Player Core 2, searchable rules and attribution, standard feat slots through the selected level, extra-choice notes, and custom options. Choices survive refresh and player/GM files. Compatibility guidance is advisory and granted effects are recorded rather than applied. GM review and tailoring remain protected.

items.title: Collapse GM file controls after loading a character
items.notes: Shorten the initial import guidance and collapse the file controls after a successful character or GM package import. A compact replacement row keeps them available without taking space from session notes.

items.title: Guide class, general, and skill feat choices
items.notes: Added a skippable feat step with 1,418 Remaster Player Core options, class-specific schedules, background and class fixed grants, common heritage/ancestry bonus choices, Fighter daily choices, and manual slots for subclass or conditional grants. Choices, notes, and inactive selections survive refresh and player/GM files. Prerequisites remain advisory and effects are not automatically applied. GM review and tailoring stay protected.

items.title: Guide spell and cantrip selection
items.notes: Add a skippable class and level based spell step with searchable Remaster Core rules, prepared spells, repertoires, cantrips, and separate learned, focus, and innate choices. Save plans in native character files and review them in the protected GM workspace.

items.title: Add starting equipment and a bulk planner
items.notes: Add a skippable starting equipment step with curated Player Core gear, custom lines, editable unit prices and Bulk, optional per-character wealth, and Strength-based carrying limits. Include plans in character files and protected GM review.

items.title: Export player characters for Foundry VTT
items.notes: Export a player-only Character actor for Foundry 14 with PF2e 8.7.0. Transfer level, modifiers, skills, Lore, and inventory. Link remaining build choices in Campaign Notes. Verify the mapping against the pinned system source and browser download. Keep native Masque backups and GM packages separate.

items.title: Support multiple saved character drafts
items.notes: Add a local library of named player drafts with independent progress and an active draft picker. Preserve existing saves as Character 1. Import into a new draft or explicitly replace the active draft. Keep the native character file and protected GM package separate.

items.title: Protect unsaved GM notes
items.notes: Show unsaved status and package export beside the editor. A valid replacement or regeneration offers Export package, Discard edits, or Cancel. Warn on page exit while edits differ from the loaded or last exported notes. Verified replacement, regeneration, export failure and retry, and the native refresh warning in Chromium.

items.title: Show next actions at the top of build review
items.notes: Show up to three next actions ordered by unfinished mechanics, advisory checks, and optional choices. Open each editor directly and restore scroll and focus on return, with a fallback when the action is resolved. Preserve export for partial drafts. Verified the review round trip in Chromium at 360 CSS pixels.

items.title: Improve touch targets and contrast for dim rooms
items.notes: Use 44 CSS-pixel minimums for shared buttons and full-width disclosure rows. Improve text, field outlines, and keyboard focus in the dark theme. Verified button and quantity sizes, disclosure taps, focus, and wrapping in Chromium at 360 x 800 and 768 x 1024. Checked sampled normal text against a 4.5:1 minimum and inspected simulated dim layouts.

items.title: Offer optional skill planning as soon as boosts are complete
items.notes: Open the skill planner from completed boosts or a relevant feat slot. Return to the originating control with its position, focus, and editor choices preserved. Display recorded skill ranks at the feat slot's level as advisory guidance. Verified the round trip, saved choices, and draft isolation in Chromium.

items.title: Clarify handoff, backup, and attribute sharing
items.notes: Label GM handoff, backup and restore, and attribute sharing by purpose. Name character JSON downloads after the draft. The shared-build preview names the destination; offers a backup; and explains replacement of attributes, clearing the skill plan, and retention of the other draft sections. Verified handoff, preview, cancellation, apply, and restore in Chromium.

items.title: Profile draft saves and improve recovery
items.notes: Profiled one typical draft and eight developed drafts at 360 x 800 with 4x CPU throttling in Chromium. The final p95 next-frame samples were 18.4 ms for typing and 33.5 ms for switching. Batched writes while typing, kept the existing storage format and stale-write check, and added status, retry, recovery export, and an exit warning when saving fails.
